title: Listen and Choose a Response — Commuting

questions.stem: I missed the bus again this morning.

options.A: The bus driver was really friendly.
options.B: Maybe you should try the earlier one.
options.C: I'll miss you when you move.
options.D: Yes, I'll catch it again tomorrow.

questions.explanation: Suggesting an earlier bus is a practical reply; the second option repeats 'miss' with a different meaning.
questions.speaker: m6
